duration_once_it_can_begin.note: The registered rule fixes the DURATION and not the start. This figure is a property of the rule and is unchanged from Stage B. It is NOT a projected completion date, because there is no start to add it to.
duration_once_it_can_begin.reason: 20 windows at the registered cap of 4 per UTC day

projected_completion_utc.detail: The projection is registered to run from the first window ACTUALLY collected, and none has been. Zero of 20 windows are accepted, at n = 3 attempts, every one refused on the at-the-money reference leg. **A projected completion date computed from a hypothetical start would be a schedule for a census that cannot begin**, and the blocker is not time: it is that no real-time market data subscription covers MBT on this account, so no window can be accepted on any day.

what_must_clear_before_a_start_exists: A real-time market data subscription covering CME crypto (MBT) on this account. Measured: broker error 354 on all three registered legs under a real-time request, and error 10167 offering delayed data instead, across n = 5 independent sessions between 19:11Z and 19:42Z. The absence is persistent across sessions, not a transient outage in one.
why_delayed_data_does_not_start_it: Registered Section 3.4 refuses a delayed tick, and Section 3.1 refuses the whole straddle when the reference leg is refused. Delayed quotes were served on all three legs and were refused rather than widened into a cost band. Deribit's 22.50 bps remains REFERENCE ONLY and no gap is filled from it.
